properties.name:
The v0.46.0 version bump. The design meaning of a cut lives in the Release and its epoch, not in a version string, so nothing the file describes behaves differently.

📌 ACCEPTED BEFORE the manifest is frozen, deliberately: `release_includes_all` freezes each artifact's CURRENT checksum, so accepting after would record that v0.46.0 shipped the pre-bump file. The release-cut annex records this ordering as costing a gate failure and a second export every time it is got wrong.
